description: This file defines the `ZoomActivity` class which demonstrates an animation to zoom an image thumbnail to full-screen and back in an Android application. It handles user interaction, image scaling, and view animations.

classes.name: ZoomActivity
classes.description: An Android FragmentActivity subclass that implements image zoom animations for thumbnails.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, registers click listeners for thumbnail views, and retrieves system animation duration.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically the navigation up action.

methods.name: zoomImageFromThumb
methods.description: Performs the zoom-in and zoom-out animation between thumbnail and full-screen image.
